1. (Currently Amended) An association method, comprising:
identifying candidate file sets from a plurality of application files, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application files, wherein each candidate file set is identified based on __quantitative analysis of file relationships and patterns within the plurality of application files__;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with application files of one of the candidate file sets according to a detected selection of the content indicative of the one of the candidate file set.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the candidate file sets include at least one of __a frequent file set identified through pattern analysis, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, wherein the candidate file sets are identified based on support metrics and file clustering algorithms__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises __constructing a data structure representing quantitative information about frequent patterns found within the plurality of application files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the data structure__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets having __a support metric exceeding a predetermined threshold support value, wherein support is determined by analyzing the frequency and co-occurrence of files across the plurality of application files__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein identifying candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold size, __wherein size is determined by the number of files within each candidate file set__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the content presented for that candidate file set is indicative of at least one of a support metric and a size of the candidate file set, __wherein the support metric reflects the frequency of the candidate file set across the plurality of application files__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of Claim 1, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, the method comprising:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes the relationship between the application and the files within the candidate file set__;
and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the unrecognized files correspond to files matching the pattern defined by the rule__.

8. (Currently Amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having instructions stored thereon that when executed by a processing resource implement a system comprising a file set engine, a presentation engine, and an association engine, wherein:
the file set engine is configured to examine a plurality of unrecognized files of two or more computing devices and identify candidate file sets from the plurality, each candidate file set including a cluster of related but unrecognized application files, __wherein the file set engine identifies candidate file sets based on quantitative analysis of file relationships and patterns__;
the presentation engine is configured to present content indicative of each identified candidate file set; and
the association engine is configured to detect a selection of content indicative of one of the candidate file sets and associate an application with an application file of that one of the candidate file sets.

9. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets that include at least one of __a frequent file set identified through pattern analysis, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, wherein the candidate file sets are identified based on support metrics and file clustering algorithms__.

10. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to __construct a data structure representing quantitative information about frequent patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identify the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets from the data structure__.

11. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets having __a support metric exceeding a predetermined threshold, wherein support is determined by analyzing the frequency and co-occurrence of files across the plurality of unrecognized files__.

12. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein the file set engine is configured to identify candidate file sets of sizes exceeding a predetermined threshold, __wherein size is determined by the number of files within each candidate file set__.

13. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the presentation engine is configured to present content for that candidate file set that is indicative of at least one of a support metric and a file set size of the candidate file set, __wherein the support metric reflects the frequency of the candidate file set across the plurality of unrecognized files__.

14. (Currently Amended) The medium of Claim 8, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality, wherein the association engine is configured to generate a rule based on the association between the application and its corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes the relationship between the application and the files within the candidate file set__; and the system includes a recognition engine configured to process the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, __wherein the unrecognized files correspond to files matching the pattern defined by the rule__.

15. (Currently Amended) A system comprising a processing resource and a __non-transitory__ computer readable medium and instructions stored on the medium, wherein the instructions, when executed, cause the processing resource to implement a method, comprising:
examining a plurality of unrecognized application files of two or more computing devices to identify candidate file sets from the plurality, __wherein candidate file sets are identified based on quantitative analysis of file relationships and patterns__;
presenting content indicative of each of the candidate file sets; and
associating an application with the application files of a given one of the candidate file sets according to a selection of the content indicative of that candidate file set.

16. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 15, wherein the identified candidate file sets include at least one of __a frequent file set identified through pattern analysis, a common application package file set, a common version file set, and a common directory file set, wherein the candidate file sets are identified based on support metrics and file clustering algorithms__.

17. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 15, wherein examining comprises __constructing a data structure representing quantitative information about frequent patterns found within the set of unrecognized files and identifying the candidate file sets that are frequent file sets utilizing the data structure__.

18. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 15, wherein identifying the candidate file sets comprises identifying candidate file sets having __a support metric exceeding a first predetermined threshold and a size exceeding a second predetermined threshold, wherein support is determined by analyzing the frequency and co-occurrence of files across the plurality of unrecognized application files__.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 15, wherein, for each identified candidate file set, the content presented for that candidate file set is indicative of at least one of a support metric and a file set size of the candidate file set, __wherein the support metric reflects the frequency of the candidate file set across the plurality of unrecognized application files__.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of Claim 15, wherein the plurality of application files is a first plurality and wherein the method further comprises:
generating a rule based on the association between the application and its associated candidate file set, __wherein the rule encodes the relationship between the application and the files within the candidate file set__; and
processing the rule to automatically associate unrecognized files of a second plurality of application files with the application, the unrecognized files corresponding to one or more files of the corresponding candidate file set, __wherein the unrecognized files match the pattern defined by the rule__.
